title: Hidden miner: svc-update.exe tried to mine on this PC
summary: it logged in to mine at a mining pool (gulf.moneroocean.stream), which the miner trap answers

program.name: svc-update.exe
program.signature: None. Nobody vouches for this file.

reasons: it tried to mine cryptocurrency on this PC
checklist: If you didn't start a miner yourself: kill it (Yes in the alert, or `aba kill` with the alert's number).
Miners come back by themselves. Look in Task Scheduler and in Settings > Apps > Startup for anything you don't recognise, and in the alert for where the program came from.
What brings a miner (a cracked game, a cheat, a "free" tool) often brings a stealer too. From another device, change your important passwords, email first.
You can report the wallet in the alert to the mining pool it wanted: pools block wallets that malware mines for.
Run a Microsoft Defender Offline scan, then strongly consider resetting Windows: stealers often drop more malware.
Look the file up on VirusTotal from another device: https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/3be1d7a0c2f94e8a6b51d03f7c9e2a48b6d1f0e39c75a28d4e6b9f1c0a3d5e72
